description:
The Pink Ride Everyone Will Talk About
Two Stunning Styles. One Iconic Color. Meet the ZUGO Gloss Pink Exclusive Edition.
Turn heads wherever you ride with the ZUGO Gloss Pink Step-Over and Step-Thru – Exclusive Edition.
This is more than just an e-bike; it's a statement. Finished in a stunning gloss pink, these exclusive editions are designed for riders who want something truly unique.
Whether you prefer the bold, classic design of the Step-Over or the easy-access comfort of the Step-Thru, both models combine eye-catching style with exceptional performance.
Available exclusively with our 20Ah long-range battery, these bikes deliver extended range and premium performance in one unforgettable package.
For a limited time, enjoy:

Designed as commuter-friendly hybrids, both ZUGO models are engineered to handle a variety of terrains while delivering exceptional comfort, stability, and control.
Whether you're cruising through city streets or exploring off-road trails, ZUGO's signature frame geometry provides a confident, comfortable riding experience.
Powered by an upgraded 750W Bafang G062 rear hub motor, the Gloss Pink Step-Over and Step-Thru feature:

Premium 20Ah lithium-ion battery for extended range
Multiple gears for effortless climbing and cruising
Integrated thumb throttle
Front suspension fork
Front and rear integrated lights
Full fenders
Upgraded fat tires designed for all-terrain riding
From pavement and gravel to sand, snow, hills, and desert trails, these bikes are built for wherever your adventures take you.

Choose Your Perfect Pink Ride
Gloss Pink Step-Over – A bold, classic frame design for riders who love a sporty look and a standout riding experience.
Gloss Pink Step-Thru – All the same premium performance and stunning gloss pink finish, with a convenient low-step frame that makes getting on and off the bike easier and more comfortable.
Special Benefits for Austin Customers: If you're located in Austin, we'll fully assemble your bike so it's ready to ride when you pick it up.
Professional Assembly in just $75 Plus, enjoy an additional $600 Austin Energy Rebate on your ZUGO e-bike purchase!
Both the Gloss Pink Step-Over and Gloss Pink Step-Thru Exclusive Editions are arriving in limited quantities. Once they're sold out, there's no guarantee these exclusive pink editions will be available again.
If you've been waiting for an e-bike that stands out from the crowd while delivering premium performance, this is your opportunity.
Important note: The Gloss Pink Step-Over and Step-Thru e-bikes are expected to ship in late October 2026. Both models are currently available for PRE-ORDER ONLY.
Quantities are limited, and pre-orders are subject to availability.
